english.title: Impersonate / make a statement / do an act falsely suggesting you were a member of the M.O.D. Police
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), with intent to deceive,

(A)_[impersonated]_
(B)_[made a statement calculated falsely to suggest that you were]_
(C)_[did an act, namely **(..SPECIFY ACT..), calculated falsely to suggest that you were]_

a member of the Ministry of Defence Police
english.legislation: Contrary to section 5(1) of the Ministry of Defence Police Act 1987.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
with intent to deceive
impersonated a member of the MOD Police OR
made a statement falsely to suggest that
you were a member of the MOD Police OR
did an act calculated falsely to suggest that
you were a member of the MOD Police

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
